purpose: NGCC Round-1 candidate reference implementations and specification documents (submitter materials). Harness/ABI glue lives in Tongsuo-Project/NGCC-provider, not here.

harness_lineage.note: ngcc-provider upstream was originally curated from this harness; algorithm sources come from submitter archives with later author revisions taking precedence.

specs.note: Algorithm specifications / 中文资料 / Supporting Documentation (non-IP). Basic information / 算法基本信息 (incl. signed forms) are not kept. Implementation trees follow submitter package layout (not flattened).

security_levels.candidates_keeps: All submitter Reference Implementation security levels present in Round-1 packages, including 512-bit (and NIST Level-5 / Aigis-*-III where that maps to 512 classical).
security_levels.provider_tests: NGCC-provider integrates and tests only 128-bit and 256-bit (plus select 192) security levels; 384/512 are kept here for archive completeness but are not tested in the provider.
security_levels.note: Parameter names containing 512 as a polynomial dimension (e.g. yuanyang-512, CTL-257-512, NEV_512_*) are not necessarily 512-bit security; see NGCC_PROPOSALS_SUMMARY in the provider.
